title: Laddu, Chintu and the A-B-C Thank-You Basket
learning: first letters of words (A is for apple)
moral: When someone helps you, a big thank you makes two hearts happy.
description: Dadaji helps everyone in Masti Nagar, so Laddu and Chintu want to say a big thank you with a special basket: one gift for A, one for B, one for C and one for D! But Golu the goat is VERY hungry. Learn first letters of words like A is for apple and B is for balloon in this funny animated story about gratitude, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Good morning, Masti Nagar! Guess who is the busiest helper in town? Our Dadaji!
He fixed Chintu's wobbly glasses. He tied up Laddu's torn kite. He even found Golu's lost bell!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! All fixed! Now Dadaji will rest his eyes... just for a... zzzzz...

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Dadaji helps everyone, every single day. But who says thank you to Dadaji?

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Hmm... IDEA! We'll make Dadaji a super-duper thank-you surprise!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: A Thank-You Basket! With one gift for A, one for B, one for C, and one for D!
Every word starts with a letter. Let's find gifts that start with A, B, C and D!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Easy peasy! A is for... JALEBI!
Hee hee! No, Laddu! Jalebi starts with J! Friends, what starts with A? It's red, round and crunchy...
APPLE! A is for apple! You're so smart!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: An apple for Dadaji? Leave it to Pinky! Here you go!
Laddu popped the shiny red apple into the basket. One gift done!
But then... CHOMP! CHOMP! CHOMP! Golu gobbled the apple, all in one go!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Golu! FWEEEEEET!
Pinky's whistle was so loud, Golu spun round and round like a wibble-wobble top!
Then kind Pinky found one more apple. A is for apple... again!
Next, B! What starts with B? Look up! It's round and floaty and goes up, up, up!
BALLOON! B is for balloon! Wah!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: I'll blow the biggest balloon ever! Phoooo... phoooooo...
The balloon got bigger... and BIGGER... and then... PFFFFT! ZIP! It zoomed round Chintu's head, and his glasses slid right off!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Ha ha ha! Chintu, your balloon is faster than a rocket!
Second try, Laddu tied a tight knot. A big blue balloon! B is for balloon!
Now C! At the lotus pond stood a tall coconut tree. C is for coconut!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! Golu, give the tree a teeny-tiny bump!
But Golu gave it a GIANT bump instead. BONK!
Down came a coconut... BOING! It bounced right off Laddu's big round tummy!
The coconut rolled down the path, and Laddu rolled after it like a ball! Roly-poly, roly-poly!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Got it! C is for coconut! Into the basket!

popups.sub: D is for Drum, Duck, Door

narration.text: The sky turned orange and pink. Only one letter left... D!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: D is for... dosa? Ooh! D is for delicious JALEBI!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Laddu! Jalebi starts with J! Your tummy is doing the thinking again!
Can YOU think of something that starts with D?
Drum! Duck! Door! Wah, so many D words!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: But which D thing will Dadaji love the most?

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! A really good one this time! D is for... DADAJI!

narration.text: That night, the courtyard twinkled with little lamps. Dadaji woke up and stretched.

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Surprise, Dadaji! A Thank-You Basket, just for you!
A for apple. B for balloon. C for coconut. And D...

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: D is for DADAJI! Thank you for helping us every single day!
And they gave him the biggest, squishiest hug in Masti Nagar!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! My moustache is wiggling with happiness! Thank YOU, my little helpers!
Let's remember! What letter does apple start with?
A! A is for apple! Super!
And what letter does balloon start with?
B! Wow, you're a letter champion!
A, B, C, D! Apple, balloon, coconut... and Dadaji!

narration.text: Dadaji shared the coconut and the apple with everybody. Yummy!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: When someone helps you, say thank you. It makes two hearts happy!
Even Golu wanted to say thank you...

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
...and then CHOMP! He nibbled the whole basket!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Golu! B is for BASKET, not for breakfast! Arre wah, now J is for JALEBI time!
